title: Member 4 Paper-Based Scientific Validation Phase 2

paper.title: Physics-informed neural network for lithium-ion battery degradation stable modeling and prognosis
evidence_inspected: Publisher-hosted full article, including Feature extraction, SOH estimation, Discussion, and Methods
Main-text Figure 3 visual labels for feature IDs 1-16
Publisher Supplementary Information, 15 pages; Supplementary Note 2 printed page 6 equations
limitations: Paper defines its own 16-feature method and does not claim to generate the SOHbenchmark 67-feature workbook schema.
Supplementary prose lists duration before accumulated charge while Figure 3 labels feature 5 as CC Q and feature 6 as CC charge time; numbering follows the figure and the mismatch is disclosed.
Current interval is printed as 0.5 A to 0.1 A; coverage counting uses ordered inclusive bounds [0.1, 0.5] A, without implying endpoint inclusion in the source.

items.claim: The paper proposes 16 numbered charging features.
items.evidence: Main text Feature extraction and Figure 3.

items.claim: XJTU voltage window is [V_end-0.2, V_end], with a 4.2 V cutoff.
items.evidence: Main text Feature extraction and Data generation.

items.claim: Current values between 0.5 A and 0.1 A are selected during CV.
items.evidence: Main text Feature extraction; Supplementary Note 2.

items.claim: Arithmetic mean is defined for selected curve values.
Sample standard deviation uses denominator n-1.
The paper prints its skewness and kurtosis central-moment formulas.
Accumulated charge is the integral of I dt over a selected interval.
The selected voltage slope is the endpoint voltage change divided by duration.
The generic curve entropy expression is -sum(p_i log(p_i)).
items.evidence: Supplementary Note 2, equation (8); probability construction remains unspecified.

items.claim: A current-slope feature is included in the 16 inputs.
items.evidence: Main text and Figure 3, feature 15; exact equation is not specified.

items.claim: Paper min-max normalizes its 16 features to [-1, 1].
Paper SOH is cycle capacity divided by nominal capacity.
items.evidence: Methods equation (5); XJTU nominal capacity stated as 2 Ah.

items.claim: Paper XJTU experiment has 55 LISHEN NCM cells and six protocols.
items.evidence: Main text Data generation and Supplementary Note 1.

items.claim: Paper model evaluation includes 387 batteries, 310705 samples, approximately 6:2:2 battery splits, and 10 repetitions.
The paper reports 0.87% MAPE in its abstract.
items.evidence: Paper abstract; this is not a VoltTwin result.

items.claim: Paper specifies missing-data handling, endpoint inclusion, exact time units, current slope equation, entropy estimator, and scaler fit scope.
items.evidence: Not fully specified in the inspected article or supplement.

items.claim: An exact paper feature extraction mode exists in VoltTwin.
items.evidence: Current Member 4 implementation contains the 67 candidate methods only; no Paper-16 implementation was added because it cannot validate the original 67.

items.claim: The 16 paper features are the source definitions of the SOHbenchmark XJTU 67 workbook columns.
items.evidence: No mapping exists in the paper, supplement, or author 16-column input schema; the schemas are distinct.

notes: Candidate means and moments use 257-point uniform-time interpolation and population ddof=0 standard deviation; paper statistics are defined on selected curve values and specify n-1 standard deviation.
Paper voltage and current windows differ from the candidate CC, CV, dV, and dI windows.
The candidate 16-bin histogram entropy is not established by the paper's generic entropy equation.
Paper time units and charge integration implementation are not specified; current-slope equation is not given.

local_prepared_data_window_coverage.scope: Inclusive raw value-band coverage only; no feature values were computed or compared.

current_value_band.reason_cv_filter_not_applied: No authoritative CV phase boundary is available in the prepared local representation.

lineage_limitations: Local SOHbenchmark traces contain 128 prepared samples per cycle; exact lineage from the original acquisition stream is undocumented.
Matching the paper's 55 profile count does not prove that the local prepared records are cycle-identical to the paper's feature-generation inputs.
No authoritative cycle key links the prepared MAT traces to the 67-feature workbook rows.

feature_value_validation.reason: No exact feature/window/statistic equivalence and no identity-mapped paper feature reference values exist for the 67 candidates.
feature_value_validation.result: No feature-value comparison is scientifically justified. The results CSV is only sample-window coverage.

datasets.name: XJTU

datasets.name: TJU

datasets.name: HUST
datasets.details: 1.1 Ah and 3.3 V nominal; 30 degC; identical charge protocol with multi-stage discharge protocols.

datasets.name: MIT
datasets.chemistry: LFP chemistry, described as the same chemistry as HUST
